commands.label: List symbols in file
commands.description: Lists the functions, classes and other symbols of the file in a picker.
examples: gO, main → the cursor moves to the main function
commands.rationale: Neovim uses gO for the symbols of the buffer; o for outline in the File group.

deviation.shadows: Vim gO, which lists the headings of a help or man page
deviation.note: Both IDEs list the symbols of any file.
